title: Scenic Full City Tour of Miami and MBeach. Everyday 2pm
blurb:
OUR TOUR DEPARTS DAILY
8:30 AM FROM BAYSIDE MARKETPLACE/9:00 AM FROM SOUTH BEACH
Explore the very best of Miami in one unforgettable tour. Discover the history of Miami Beach, South Beach, the Art Deco District, and Ocean Drive. Drive inside exclusive Star Island, home to some of the city's most famous Celebrities, then explore the vibrant murals and street art of Wynwood. Enjoy a stop at Bayside Marketplace before visiting Brickell City Centre and the mouth of the Miami River for some of the city's best skyline views. Finally, experience the energy of Little Havana, where you'll learn about Cuban history, visit a traditional cigar factory, enjoy live music, and have the chance to try a Cuban sandwich or a mojito.

To make your experience even better, we include complimentary digital photos, bottled water, and soft drinks.
